title: Front, Rear, and 360 Camera Feedback
summary: Feedback centers on front, rear, and 360 camera behavior, with clear praise for parking assistance but many fragments that only describe positioning, activation, limitations, or preferences without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the rear and 360 cameras for convenience and making parking easier.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe camera placement, app behavior, sensor limits, and user preferences, but many examples are informational or incomplete rather than clearly evaluative.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined, which limits clear interpretation of overall customer sentiment.
Some examples are incomplete or purely descriptive, so the topic includes camera-related mentions without enough context to classify them more precisely.
One positive example discusses liking the front more than the rear appearance rather than camera functionality, which suggests the cluster may include some loosely related front or rear mentions.
